how_fast.title: How does Vantex Bank's fast credit work?
how_fast.desc1: The fastest credit is obtained online. It is now the preferred solution for financing a project, facing an unexpected expense or quickly obtaining additional cash flow.
how_fast.desc2: However, when a financing need becomes urgent, the hardest part is not always getting the money. It's often identifying the body capable of accepting the request and validating the file as quickly as possible.
how_fast.desc3: As a specialist in fast credit, Vantex Bank has developed a solution that allows multiple organizations to be queried from a single form. This approach saves valuable time.
how_fast.desc4: And to make the steps even simpler, once the credit is accepted, the client only has to provide their supporting documents online and sign their contract electronically. It is this method that makes it possible to obtain credit as quickly as possible.

advantages.item3: Digital supporting documents and electronic signature

faq.q1: What is the difference between fast credit and express credit?
faq.a1: The terms fast credit and express credit mean the same thing. They are commercial names used to talk about a credit whose request, study of the file and response are accelerated thanks to simplified digital paths.
faq.q2: What is the fastest credit to get?
faq.a2: When it's already open, revolving credit is often the fastest financing. For a new application, an online personal loan usually constitutes the best compromise between speed, amount that can be borrowed and cost of financing.
faq.q3: Can I get a fast credit online?
faq.a3: Yes. At Vantex Bank, it is possible to fill out a form, receive a decision in principle, sign the contract electronically and transmit supporting documents without traveling.
faq.q4: How long does it take to get a response?
faq.a4: The study of your file starts as soon as the form is submitted. A decision in principle is generally immediate, and the final validation occurs within 24h to 48h after receipt of the supporting documents.

unexpected.title: A solution for unexpected expenses
unexpected.desc1: One of the most frequent cases is the occurrence of an unexpected expense. A car breakdown, an urgent repair in the home, the replacement of an essential household appliance or an unexpected bill can quickly unbalance a budget.
unexpected.desc2: When these expenses cannot wait for the next inflow of money, a mini credit allows you to quickly have the necessary funds to deal with the situation.
unexpected.desc3: Mini credit can also be used to finance many other low-value purchases:
unexpected.footer: In this type of situation, mini credit allows you to spread an expense over time without having to immediately mobilize your savings. It thus constitutes a practical solution to realize a project while preserving your budget.

faq.label: Help Center
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
faq.desc: Find here the answers to the most common questions about our financing services.
faq.q1: How to get a mini credit quickly?
faq.a1: The mini credit application is made directly online at Vantex Bank. You just need to complete your file and transmit the requested information. To speed up the payment of funds, it is recommended to sign your contract electronically as soon as possible.
faq.q2: What are the rates of a mini credit?
faq.a2: The rate of a mini credit depends in particular on the amount borrowed and the repayment period. Before any subscription, it is important to check the APR, the amount of the installments as well as the total cost of the credit which appear on your personalized contract.
faq.q3: What salary do I need to get a mini credit?
faq.a3: There is no strict minimum salary to obtain a mini credit with us. The study of the file takes into account your entire financial situation, in particular your income, your expenses and your overall repayment capacity.
faq.a4: Mini credit is ideal for dealing with an unexpected expense (car breakdown, urgent repair, unexpected bill) or for financing a small purchase (computer, smartphone, trip) without immediately mobilizing your savings.
faq.cta_desc: Our advisors are at your disposal to support you in your steps.
